sentences.text: The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — PVL 3827, was discovered in the Los Colorados Formation of northwestern Argentina. It contains a complete skull, lower jaws, and a nearly complete skeleton collected during the late 1960s.
Three additional specimens are known, including PVL 3828, which is almost as complete and features a nearly intact skull.
Its family, Ornithosuchidae, included facultatively bipedal pseudosuchians — reptiles that could walk on two or four legs — adapted for scavenging.
A 2026 study of the snout's neurovascular anatomy suggests a sensory system similar to extant crocodilians and birds, supporting wading-foraging behavior.
The time range is recorded as Norian to Norian, spanning from 227.3 to 205.7 million years ago.
